notes: New effect: Vector Delay. Every particle is its own delay line, and where it is and how it moves sets the time, pitch, pan, level and filter of its line. Forces or flow, an emitter that launches particles on the beat, reverse, pitch shift with Recycle, 14 presets. Find it under Delay & space. This completes the six particle devices (Bouncy Notes, Emit, Vector Grain, Vector FM, Vector Map, Vector Delay).
